title: Navy Establishes New Deputy Chief Of Naval Operations to Support Failing Shore Infrastructure
summary: WASHINGTON NAVY YARD – Navy shore infrastructure will be in failing condition by 2037 if the sea service continues to use its current funding schedule, the new deputy chief of naval operations told USNI News on Thursday. As the newly created deputy chief of naval operations of sustainment, Vice Adm. Scott Gray, who will report on Oct. 5, will be tasked with continuously pushing for funding for shore infrastructure, including barracks and piers. “The idea is to continue the efforts to revitalize the shore, make wise investments and kind of bring the shore infrastructure back to where it needs to
author: Heather Mongilio
